tree.instruction.md: file; <6000 chars; backticked /app paths; trailer 'You have <int> seconds to complete this task. Do not cheat by using online solutions or hints specific to this task.'

environment/.data/: flat dir of files (zip allowed as a file); no subdirectories; >= min_inputs files

tests/.test_output.py: rewardkit @criterion checks + criteria.<name>(weight=W); embeds environment/data as zlib+base64

_forbidden: any extra file in solution/ (format-recovery check) or tests/

root.artifacts: list[str] absolute paths; must equal templates/<archetype>/archetype.toml artifacts exactly (vb §1.12)

task.name: "terminal-bench/<bundle-name>"
task.authors: list of {name: 'Full Name' (>=2 capitalised words, not a placeholder), email: '<...>@ethara.ai'}

metadata.category: one of 16 display strings from gb _CATEGORIES (QC accepts any non-empty string)

task_toml._source: Terminal_2.0_Harbor_Harness/Input Bundle Generator New/templates/*/task.toml:1-47 (identical in all 8)

environment_dockerfile.agent_account: RUN groupadd -g 1000 agent && useradd -u 1000 -g 1000 -m -d /home/agent -s /bin/bash agent; ENV HOME=/home/agent
environment_dockerfile.apt: single RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends xxd file curl bash nodejs npm procps ca-certificates tmux && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
environment_dockerfile.openhands: python3.12 -m venv /opt/openhands-sdk-venv; pip install openhands-sdk==1.55.1 openhands-tools==1.55.1 litellm==1.105.0 fastapi; import check; chmod -R a+rX

tests_dockerfile: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends util-linux && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

test_output_py.registration: module-level criteria.<check_name>(weight=W), W in {1,3,5,-1,-3,-5}, bijective with top-level functions decorated @criterion(description=...) (no braces in description)

judge._rule: exactly these 5 keys in this order (gb:1903-1937)

annotations.contract_sentence: optional, must appear verbatim in instruction.md (playground A3)

judge_toml._rules: >=8 criteria, >=1 positive, >=1 negative, sum|neg| <= sum pos

reward_toml.text:
[[reward]]
name = "reward"
aggregation = "weighted-sum"
weights = { test_output = <0.5/P_test>, judge = <0.5/P_judge> }

[scoring.test_output]
aggregation = "weighted-sum"
reward_toml.formula: reward = 0.5*sum_i(v_i*w_i)/P_test + 0.5*sum_j(v_j*w_j)/P_judge, v in {0,1}; no clamp; floor -1.0
reward_toml.step10_copy: Input_Bundle_QC/exe_copy.py rewrites to weights = { test_output = 1/P_test } and drops the judge, so oracle must read exactly 1.0 and nop 0.0
